Hi everyone, I sollicit reviews for my PR #37010 which involves linear algebra and basic lie algebra notions.

It formalizes finrank_weightSpace_eq_one_of_isIrreducible for sl₂, showing that if K is an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, then each non-trivial weight space of a finite-dimensional irreducible representation of sl(2, K) has dimension 1.

The entire change is roughly 300 lines and is completely self-contained within a single file, so it should be a straightforward read. Besides, the formalization is most if not all about linear algebra, which is also explained in the PR #37010.

All tests have passed, and the PR is ready for review.

Please feel free to comment. I’d be very grateful for any feedback. Thanks in advance!
